# Abstract

Dietary inflammation (DI) and suitable vitamin D intake was associated
with frailty. However, the possible mechanism that how DI affected
frailty was still unclear. The current study aimed to explore the
mediating association of vitamin D levels in the link between DI and
frailty. A cross-sectional study of 1172 participants from the National
